guilt_prone: This means avoiding misdeeds because one's conscience and picture of oneself would condemn them: a wrong gnaws at one though nobody knows of it, and confessing it brings relief.
shame_prone: This means avoiding misdeeds because others would see and condemn them: stung by ridicule or rejection, even imagined, untroubled by a fault that never gets out, and finding no relief in confessing.
punishment_fearing: This means avoiding misdeeds because one fears being punished for them, whether by the courts, the gods, hellfire, karma, vengeful spirits or a lynch mob: confessing only to lighten a punishment already coming.
